findings.title: Delete menu item never renders in the list view because it requires rulerRule
findings.body: The delete menu item is guarded by `canDelete && rulerRule`. In the alert list view the whole point of this PR is that no ruler API requests are made, so consumers (RuleActionsButtons.V2 via GrafanaRuleListItem) pass only `promRule` and `rulerRule` is undefined. The new prom-based ability check will set canDelete=true, but the menu item still won't render, and `handleDelete` also requires a RulerRuleDTO. Result: users with delete permission cannot delete rules from the new list view. The pause menu item has the same problem at line 123: it is guarded by `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`, so Pause never appears in the list view even though canPause can be true via the prom rule abilities.

findings.title: Silence action in the list view opens nothing without a rulerRule
findings.body: The SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is truthy. In the list view only promRule is passed (rule is undefined), but AlertRuleMenu can now show the Silence menu item based on prom-rule abilities. Clicking 'Silence notifications' calls setShowSilenceDrawer(true) yet no drawer is ever rendered, so the action silently does nothing for list-view users.

findings.title: ModifyExport ability no longer supported for Grafana recording rules
findings.body: In useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities, AlertRuleAction.ModifyExport is `[isAlertingRule, exportAllowed]` where isAlertingRule is prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule). The ruler-based equivalent uses isGrafanaManagedAlertRule which is true for any Grafana-managed rule including recording rules. For Grafana recording rules in the list view (which now relies solely on this prom-based hook), the Export menu item disappears even though modify-export of recording rules was previously supported.

findings.title: GrafanaRuleListItem rendered without a key in the filtered list
findings.body: In the switch over origins, the 'datasource' and default branches pass key={key}, but the 'grafana' branch renders <GrafanaRuleListItem rule={rule} ... /> without the key prop. Every item in rules.map() needs a key; this produces React missing-key warnings and can cause incorrect reconciliation when the list updates (e.g. rule states changing between polls).

findings.title: Rule view link lost the returnTo parameter
findings.body: The old GrafanaRuleListItem (in deleted GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx) built the href with createReturnTo() so that navigating back from the rule view returned the user to the list. The new component uses createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`) without returnTo, regressing back-navigation behavior for users coming from the list view.

findings.title: No unit tests for the new prom-based ability hooks
findings.body: useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities / useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable are new permission-critical code (folder permission checks, provisioned/plugin-provided immutability, silence support) but the PR adds no direct tests for them; existing tests only mock these hooks. Edge cases like folder still loading, invalid folderUid, provisioned prom rules, and recording-rule silencing are untested, and a regression here would show/hide edit/delete/silence controls incorrectly.
